app.title: Zombee Product Manager
products.column.name: Name
products.empty_state: No products yet. Click "Add Simple Product" or "Add Variable Product" to get started.
products.clear_all_empty: There are no products to clear.
products.clear_all_confirm_prompt:
This will permanently delete all {count} product(s) from your local database. This cannot be undone.

Type DELETE to confirm:
app.factory_reset_confirm_prompt:
This deletes EVERYTHING: all products, and your saved site connection (site URL, username, and application password). This cannot be undone. You'll need to reconnect in Settings before syncing again.

Type RESET to confirm:
app.factory_reset_done: Done. All products and site connection details have been cleared.
product_form.name: Product Name
product_form.categories_help: Use ">" for subcategories and "|" for more than one, e.g. Clothing > T-Shirts|Sale
product_form.tags_help: Separate multiple tags with "|", e.g. Bestseller|Handmade
variations.no_attributes: Add at least one attribute with values first.
variations.confirm_remove: These variations no longer match your attributes and will be removed: {skus}. Continue?
product_form.save_and_sync_tooltip: Saves locally, then pushes this product straight to your WooCommerce site.
images.export_confirm_title: Clear and rebuild the upload folder?
images.export_confirm_body: This will delete everything currently in "{folder}" and replace it with the images for this export. Make sure you've already uploaded the previous batch to your website.
settings.title: Settings
settings.site_connection_help: Uses a WordPress Application Password -- go to your site's Users > Profile page, scroll to "Application Passwords", and create one named e.g. "Zombee Desktop". This does not require sharing your login password, and can be revoked any time from that same page.
settings.site_password_placeholder: xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx
settings.connection_missing_fields: Fill in the site URL, username, and application password first.
sync.not_configured: Saved locally. To also push this product to your site, set up the connection details in Settings first.
sync.success_body: {sku} was saved locally and synced to your site.
sync.failed_body: {sku} was saved locally, but the site rejected it:
